title: MiniMax H3 SelfLift + Sharpness Upscaler
description: ComfyUI serverless worker for MiniMax H3 reference-to-video with audio: Qwen3.8 local prompt rewriting, SelfLift-Avatar two-stage sampler with the H3 sharpness latent upscaler, and a choice of the stock video VAE or the 2X upscale VAE with tiled fast decode. Models auto-download to your network volume on first boot.

input.name: Auto-download models
input.description: Download missing models to the attached network volume at worker boot. Requires a ≥200GB network volume attached to the endpoint — strongly recommended.

input.name: Hugging Face token
input.description: Optional — only for gated Hugging Face repos. All bundled models are public.

input.name: Civitai token
input.description: Needed only for the 2X upscale VAE used by MiniMaxH3-SelfLift-2xVAE-Sharpen-R2VA.json (Civitai download). Without it that file is skipped and only the plain-VAE SelfLift workflow works.

input.name: Job timeout (seconds)
input.description: Max seconds a single generation job may run before the worker aborts it.

input.name: ComfyUI extra args
input.description: Extra launch flags for ComfyUI. Leave empty: --fast / --use-sage-attention / --async-offload corrupt int8-convrot stacks.
